## Cat Key 1.2.3: real cat sounds

**⬇ [Download for Windows](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-Setup-x64.exe)**, or the [portable exe](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-portable-x64.exe).

### New
- **A real purr:** the background purr (the cat button on the top bar, or the tray menu) is now a real cat purring, recorded and looped without a seam.
- **Real meows:** the mews and meows on clicks and in training are real cat recordings, with the made-up voices still filling in the chirps and trills.

Everything from 1.2.2 is here too: Cat Builder step by step with an Open menu (browser or the ChatGPT and Claude apps), the whole request every time, training that stays in the trainer, the Alt and Ctrl swap, Switch cat at the top, the Unreal Engine pack and the About page on the top bar.
